{"mimeType": "text/markdown", "text": "# Runway & shutdown cash notes
Leonard - started Sep 25, updated Sep 30

## Where we are
About two months before we have to let people go unless the bridge or an engine deal lands. Keep enough aside to close the company properly (legal, final payroll, state filings). No new commitments without the three of us agreeing.

## Shutdown reserve
Legal: ask our lawyer for a quote to wind down. Final payroll and accrued PTO through Gusto. Delaware franchise tax and the annual report are due in March whatever happens.

## Money still moving (for the cuts)
An account still has money moving if anything was spent, billed or paid out on it in September 2025, or a campaign on it is still switched on. Ad revenue paid to us counts (the warehouse has it by network and month). Spend or a charge the vendor has agreed in writing to drop doesn't count. Heads up on the warehouse: the spend tables have no Meta spend after April and no Unity cost at all, so for spend go by the receipts and whether the campaign is on. The finance ledger lumps the ad network payouts together under AppLovin/MAX and runs a month behind, so for what was paid to us use the ad revenue numbers by network, not the ledger.

## Cuts
Fred: marketing, UA and socials. Arthur: engineering, stores and data tools. I'll take software subscriptions and the card.

## Open
Bridge: still talking to two funds. Engine: NCsoft is slow, follow up next week.
", "id": "f_c612c0e68a27b3330eb46a", "name": "Runway & shutdown cash notes"}

content.text:
The handover register is done and saved in the Company Ops folder. I replied to Leonard in his thread with what he asked for: one account marked TRANSFER, and the four accounts where an outsider still has access.

**Sheet:** https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1NimIPaLwFAR_BvR5AKHjMBbJkSmZ0dp-Jn9iG7S8TUQ/edit

It covers 13 accounts from Arthur's Sep 30 sweep. Arthur's rules on the Harmony Games board decided the actions. Leonard's cash notes and his DM decided whether money is still moving: anything spent, billed or paid out in September counts, but ad revenue under $100 doesn't.

| Action | Accounts |
|---|---|
| **TRANSFER (1)** | X @harmonygames: only you hold it, on your login, with no delegates |
| **REVOKE (4)** | Node Media LLC still has access on the Meta Domino Delights ad account (partner admin), the Unity Ads advertiser (admin), TikTok @harmonygames (business partner, admin) and YouTube (still an owner of the channel's Google Brand Account, even though it was removed from YouTube Studio in December) |
| **KEEP (5)** | AppLovin (September ad revenue was $136), Google Ads 569-350-5790, Instagram, LinkedIn, Discord |
| **CLOSE (3)** | AdMob pub-3556…, Google Ads 449 (Calm Play), adjoe |

A few calls you might not expect:
- **Google Ads 569:** Arthur emailed last night that Leonard wants it kept, in case a publisher takes Domino Delights and wants its history. His rules alone would have closed it.
- **Instagram:** the sweep only showed your personal Gmail login. But a Meta Business notice in your inbox lists Leonard and you as full admins, so it's held by the company and stays KEEP.
- **adjoe:** a campaign was switched on by mistake on Sep 1. adjoe confirmed in writing they won't bill those installs, so no money is moving.
- **Off the list:** AdMob pub-2341… because Google deactivated it on Aug 24, and the TikTok @harmonygames.app account because it was deactivated on Sep 29. Both closed before the sweep.

Arthur's rules also say socials marked TRANSFER go as a checklist on your "Lock up social handles and domain?" card on the UA/BD board. I added a checklist there with one item: add Leonard as an owner on X.

Nothing has been changed on the accounts themselves. Removing Node Media from those four and adding Leonard to X still have to be done in each platform.
